A '''sun''' was located in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions']]<ref name="OBF" /> [[Geroon system/Legends|Geroon system]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by the [[Geroon|eponymous]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="OBF" /> In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="TERCOBF">The events of [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] take place in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> its [[Star/Legends|sunlight]] played across the sides of the [[Vagaari slaver fleet]]'s [[Warship/Legends|warships]] during a [[Battle of Geroon|battle]] between them and [[Starship/Legends|starships]] of Geroon's [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of the [[Geroon (species)|same name]].<ref name="OBF " />

==Behind the scenes==
The sun was mentioned in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2006]] novel [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']].<ref name="OBF" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Geroon [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the star, in grid square I-8.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
